newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Bank of Korea to absorb one trln won from banks.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Korea to absorb one trln won from banks.

text.p: The Bank of Korea plans to absorb one trillion won from the banking system on Thursday through four-day repurchase agreements, an official at the bank said.
The official said the plan was to siphon off expected surplus liquidity, created mainly by the government's regular month-end cash supply to banks.
"Despite the money absorption, short-term liquidity is expected to remain relatively high," he said.
